# Game03 external visual assets — attribution & licensing

Visual-replacement assets. Refined trees/buildings/pedestrians are now used in
S01–S03; traffic logic remains unchanged. Sources and licenses are recorded per item.
Generated by `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/scripts/`.

## Pedestrians — `Pedestrians/*.fbx`

- **Source:** Ara 3D Gen (`TuriaArt/3d-gen-TU`, upstream `olatunde85/3d-gen`), built from the
  CC0 MakeHuman dataset. CLI: `npx ara3d export --detail low --no-animations --formats fbx`.
- **License:** Character base assets/data are **CC0** (public domain, commercial use allowed,
  no attribution required). Preserved in the generated export where included.
- **Files:** `Athletic_man.fbx` (174 cm, 34,704 tris, 69-bone Unity-Humanoid-compatible rig).
- **Runtime file:** `Pedestrians/StreetPedestrian_Trimmed.fbx` (~4 MB). Generated by
  `scripts/trim_pedestrian_fbx.py`: original 496 animation clips reduced to Idle/Walk/Texting/
  Phone call; rig, mesh and external 2K textures retained. Used via
  `Resources/StreetCrossing/Modules/StreetPedestrian.prefab` in S01–S03.
- The original `Athletic_man.fbx` (~70 MB) is retained for provenance and is not used at runtime.

## Trees — current refined set `Trees/*_Refined.fbx`

- **Source:** Original procedural Blender geometry authored in
  `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/scripts/generate_trees_refined.py`. Clean trunk/limb hierarchy
  with individual double-sided leaf blades (random direction, width, curl and colour) instead of
  the earlier faceted canopy blobs.
- **License:** Original project-authored geometry; **no third-party model license**. Generated
  with Blender 5.2.3; the GPL application license does not attach to the mesh output.
- **Files:** `StreetPlane_Oak_Refined.fbx` (~1.2 MB), `StreetGinkgo_Willow_Refined.fbx`
  (~747 KB), `StreetConifer_Pine_Refined.fbx` (~3.5 MB after the final density pass).
  Runtime instances are created from `Assets/StreetCrossing/Resources/StreetCrossing/Modules/RefinedTree*.prefab`.
- **Status:** These are the refined assets used in S01–S03.

## Trees — earlier MTree iteration `Trees/StreetPlane_Oak.fbx` etc. (retained, not current)

- **Source:** GoodPie `modular_tree` (MTree) 5.6.0, branch structure generated with fixed seeds
  and OAK/WILLOW/PINE presets; lightweight low-poly canopy clusters authored in Blender.
- **License:** **GPL-3.0-or-later** — see `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/third_party/LICENSE-modular_tree-GPLv3.md`.
  The generated branch geometry is an output of the GPL tool; treat the tree assets as subject
  to GPL share-alike until legal review says otherwise. Do not claim them as CC0.
- **Files:** `StreetPlane_Oak.fbx`, `StreetGinkgo_Willow.fbx`, `StreetConifer_Pine.fbx`.
  Retained for provenance; **not used by the refined test scene** because the canopy read as
  an exploding shrub.

## Building — current refined `Buildings/NearFieldResidence_Refined.fbx`

- **Source:** Original procedural Blender geometry authored in
  `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/scripts/generate_building_refined.py`: partitioned wall panels
  with real gaps, window frames with mullions and sills, recessed glazing, timber door,
  shop awning, balcony, cornice bands, roof parapet and service details.
- **License:** Original project-authored geometry; **no third-party model license**.
- **File:** `NearFieldResidence_Refined.fbx` (~53 KB, 1,040 verts / 780 faces), regenerated with
  a real UV layout so the refined stucco texture binds correctly.
- **Status:** Used in S01–S03 via `RefinedResidence.prefab`; its `FacadeMasonry` slot is bound
  to `Resources/.../PlasterRefined.mat`.

## Building — earlier Building Tools iteration `Buildings/NearFieldResidence_RealOpenings.fbx` (retained, not current)

- **Source:** `ranjian0/building_tools` v1.0.13, headless API; floorplan → floors → multigroup
  door/window cuts produce **real geometric openings**, not decals.
- **License:** **MIT** — see `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/third_party/LICENSE-building_tools-MIT.txt`.
- **File:** `NearFieldResidence_RealOpenings.fbx` (19 KB, 220 verts, 204 faces).
- **Compatibility note:** The upstream plugin's dataclass defaults are incompatible with Blender
  5.2 / Python 3.13 and its popup handler crashes in `-b` mode. A patched copy is preserved in
  `ArtSource/Game03VisualUpgrade/third_party/building_tools_py313/`.

## Toolchain

- Blender 5.2.3 LTS (installed at `D:/SoftwareManagement/apps/Blender`).
- Node v22 / npm 10 for the Ara CLI.
- Unity 2022.3.62f3c1 Built-in Render Pipeline; FBX imported natively (no glTFast/GLB path).

## Not included / unresolved

- `tevy.dev` CC0 realistic models were unreachable (proxy 502) from this machine.
- KinemIQ CC0 animation pack was downloadable but is animation-only (no human mesh); the
  Ara characters already include their rigs, so KinemIQ was not integrated.
- The refined tree canopies are finer but still stylized, not photoreal; realism is limited.
- This remains an isolated gate test, not full-street acceptance. The current evidence is
  `Results/visual-upgrade-test/refined-assets-kerb-1080p.png` and
  `Assets/StreetCrossing/Scenes/VisualUpgradeTest_Refined.unity`. See `RESULTS.md`.
